problems.title: When a company looks for this kind of engineering
problems.lead: The center of the work is a system that already runs. Evolving an MVP, including one built with an AI tool, is an entry situation. It is not the company's category.

scale.title: The system no longer matches the operation
scale.body: The first release became the real system. Failures, queues and rework show up when more customers or more data arrive.

integrations.title: The integration loses or repeats information
integrations.body: ERP, bank, old API or spreadsheet. The data does not arrive, arrives twice, or nobody knows which step stopped.

legacy.title: The old system blocks the change
legacy.body: The operation depends on a system that is hard to change. The replacement has to live with what already works.

genai.title: The MVP has to hold real use
genai.body: The product already opens, including when it was created with an AI tool. It now needs customers, real data, and an operation that cannot stop.

architecture.title: Software architecture and engineering
architecture.body: A structural decision for a system that already has users, data and a routine. What changes, what stays, and what another patch will not fix.

page.problem: The structure of the system no longer fits the operation. Each new change raises the chance of failure, and the team discusses symptoms instead of the decision that has to be made.
page.audience: Companies with a system in use, where the next change crosses teams, data, or a process that cannot stop.
page.deliver: A reading of the current structure, the risks, what is kept, and a sequence of next steps. It is not a closed project design and it is not a guarantee of results.
page.method: The work starts with the technical conversation. If there is a project, decisions are written down and the build follows parts the operation can follow.
page.evidence: No architecture metric is published. The cases page names SigaBR and 637 Tennis Club, without numbers.

backend.title: Backend development
backend.body: Services and APIs the operation uses every day. The focus is seeing failure early, receiving the data whole, and being able to follow the flow.

page.problem: The business rule lives in code that fails without a trace, or that nobody can change without fear of stopping the routine.
page.audience: Companies that need backend for a system that already has customers, an integration, or an internal routine.
page.deliver: The services, APIs and error handling agreed in scope. The site does not publish a technology list as if that were the service.
page.method: After the diagnosis, the scope is split. The build follows what was written down, with a way to see what changed.
page.evidence: No backend metric is published on this site.

integrations.title: Systems integration
integrations.body: Connecting what the company already uses, with error handling and a point where you can see where the flow stopped.

page.problem: Two systems do not tell the same story. An order, a payment, stock or a record is lost, repeated, or stuck in a step nobody can see.
page.audience: Companies that already run on an ERP, a bank, an API or a spreadsheet and need the information to cross those systems.
page.deliver: A map of the flow, the failure points, and what will be connected. The versioned SigaBR text mentions an integration with DETRAN via RENAVAM and Banco Rendimento, without a metric and without an attached document.
page.method: The diagnosis looks at the real flow before the integration is written. If the problem does not justify a project, the opinion says so.
page.evidence: The name SigaBR is published as a client, with the integration named above. This repository has no source, date or measured result.

legacy.title: Application modernization
legacy.body: Changing an old system while the operation continues. The plan says what stays up and what changes at each step.

page.problem: The system that carries the routine is hard to change. Stopping to rewrite everything is not an option the operation will accept.
page.audience: Companies whose current system still runs the business and has to change without treating downtime as a detail.
page.deliver: A reading of what the system does today, what can change in stages, and what stays out. There is no promise of a migration without interruption.
page.method: The diagnosis separates what the operation cannot lose from what can be rewritten. A project, if there is one, follows that order.
page.evidence: There is no modernization case with a measured result on this site. The cases page says what is published and what is not.

genai.title: Evolution of MVPs and products created with AI
genai.body: When the first version has to become a customer system. A review of what exists, what is kept, and what has to be rebuilt.

page.problem: The MVP works in a demo, or it was generated with an AI tool, and it now has to hold customers, real data, and an operation that cannot stop.
page.audience: Companies in that situation. It is an entry scenario. FISAM TECH does not present itself as a firm that fixes AI-generated code.
page.deliver: A reading of what the system already does, of the risks in data, access, integration and operations, and of what would make sense to keep or rebuild. The opinion may be that there is no project.
page.method: The diagnosis session comes before any rewrite. There is no published standard timeline for turning an MVP into a production system.
page.evidence: There is no public case of MVP hardening in this repository. The published names are on the cases page, without metrics.

cookieBlocks.title: Classification
paragraphs: The three cookies are strictly necessary to present the site in the language and on the commercial terms the person chose or that were suggested. Under the ANPD guidance on cookies, a cookie required for the service the person requested does not need consent.

They are stored when the person enters the site, before the notice, because there is no audience-measurement cookie for which the notice would ask permission. The notice only records, in this browser, that the person saw the information. That mark stays in local storage, under the key fisam_cookie_consent, and it is not a cookie.

cookieBlocks.title: Refusal and deletion
paragraphs: There is no optional cookie on this site to refuse, and, to delete NEXT_LOCALE, CURRENCY and COUNTRY, the person clears the cookies of this domain in the browser settings.

cookieBlocks.title: Other browser records
paragraphs: Region confirmation also stays in local storage and is not a cookie. The administrative area, outside the visitor's navigation, uses the cookie fisam_admin_session, limited to the authorized session, for up to 12 hours.

On the payment screen and on the scheduling screen, the browser may load a resource of the operator of that service. A cookie stored by that resource belongs to the operator. The person may ask for information about sharing at contato@fisamtech.com.

privacyBlocks.title: Controller
paragraphs: FISAM TECH TECNOLOGIA LTDA, a limited-liability company, a micro-enterprise, enrolled in the Brazilian corporate registry under CNPJ 59.897.573/0001-02, with its seat at Inácio Pires de Moraes, No. 549, apt. 42, block 5 B, Centro, Embu-Guaçu, State of São Paulo, ZIP 06900-070, is the controller of the personal data processed on this site. The address is the seat shown in the public CNPJ record. The data-subject channel is contato@fisamtech.com.

privacyBlocks.title: Data-subject channel
paragraphs: Enrollment as a micro-enterprise in the public CNPJ record places the controller as a small-scale processing agent, under ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD No. 2/2022. In that regime, appointment of a data-protection officer may be dispensed with. The communication channel for the data subject is mandatory and is formalized at contato@fisamtech.com, for requests under article 18 of Law 13,709/2018 and for the contact provided in article 41, paragraph 3.
Filipe Godinho Gomes, managing partner and technical lead, receives those requests on that channel, as representative of the controller.

privacyBlocks.title: Data processed
paragraphs: Commercial qualification: name, email, company, role, description of the challenge, budget range, currency, country and language. The record goes into the contact file. The country may be the one the person indicated or the country suggested from the region of access. That file has no field for IP address or browser identifier.

Diagnosis and scheduling: after the qualification form, the company releases a link with a signed token, valid for 14 days, so the person can choose a time. The session is conducted by Filipe Godinho Gomes. The deliverable is a reading of the situation, the risks observed and the next steps.

Payment and tax records: the published session costs R$ 4.990,00. The payment operator processes the payment-method data. The company keeps the operation reference, the status, the amount, the currency and the return needed to confirm payment and to meet a tax duty. The full card number does not stay in the company's file.

Ideas: name, email, phone, idea, problem and stage. Those data go into the contact file, and sending opens the messaging application published on the site, with the same content. Sending is a preliminary step. It does not hire engineering, does not transfer an equity interest, does not create a partnership and does not require an investment, until a separate instrument exists.

Report: category, account, approximate date, relationship with the company, language and an identification flag. If the person identifies themselves, also name, email, phone and the record of authorization. If they do not, the account proceeds without name, email and phone. The report record, in the application, does not store an IP address or a browser identifier. The text may identify someone, and sending passes through hosting and email. The company tries to notify contato@fisamtech.com with the protocol and an excerpt of up to 280 characters.

Navigation and internal area: the hosting environment may provide the country of access in order to suggest language and currency, without the application storing the IP address in the contact file. Use of the commercial flow may record the event, the page, the language and the contact. The administrative area, limited to authorized people, uses a 12-hour session and may store, in that session and in the access audit, the IP address and the browser identifier.

privacyBlocks.title: Legal bases
paragraphs: Commercial qualification relies on article 7, V, of Law 13,709/2018, for preliminary procedures and for performance of the diagnosis contract, when that contract is formed. While there is no contract, there is also a legitimate interest, article 7, IX, in answering the request the person themselves started, limited to the data needed to understand the request and reply.
The paid diagnosis and scheduling rely on article 7, V, performance of a contract.
Payment and tax records rely on article 7, V, performance of a contract, and on article 7, II, compliance with a legal tax and accounting duty.
The ideas page and the opening of the message rely on article 7, V, as preliminary procedures. Sending is not an engineering engagement and not an assignment of an equity interest.

A report relies on article 7, IX, legitimate interest in reviewing conduct that may affect the company and the people it deals with, and on article 7, VI, the regular exercise of rights. Identification is voluntary. Name, email and phone are included only if the person provides them and authorizes the record. If the person does not identify themselves, the account proceeds without those data.
The cookies NEXT_LOCALE, CURRENCY and COUNTRY are strictly necessary to the requested function and do not require consent, under the logic of the ANPD guidance on cookies.

Technical security and hosting records, to the extent the hosting environment and the database generate them, and the access record of the administrative area rely on article 7, IX, legitimate interest in the security of the application, and on article 7, II, when retention follows a legal duty.

privacyBlocks.title: Operators and international transfer
paragraphs: The controller uses operators for hosting, database, transactional email, payment, scheduling and messaging. Some of those operators are in Brazil and some are abroad, so personal data may be processed outside the country.

The international transfer relies on the need to perform the contract or preliminary procedures at the data subject's request, under article 33, VII, of Law 13,709/2018, and, when retention is a legal duty, on compliance with a legal obligation. The list of operators by name is given to the data subject who asks for it, at contato@fisamtech.com, under article 18, VII.

privacyBlocks.title: Security
paragraphs: The site is served over HTTPS. Access to the administrative area is limited to people authorized by the company. Integration secrets do not stay in the public repository. The public site does not load an advertising tag.

The contact file and the report record do not include, in the application, an IP address or a browser identifier. The hosting environment and the database may generate their own technical security record.

privacyBlocks.title: Professional experience and published names
paragraphs: Mentions of Bradesco, B3, Itaú, Banco Next, Capgemini Engineering and Gerdau refer to prior employment and to the earlier professional record of Filipe Godinho Gomes. They are not contracts, clients or cases of FISAM TECH.

The names published as clients are SigaBR and 637 Tennis Club, within the limit of the text already published on the site. SigaBR appears as a platform for dispatch agents and licensing, with integration to DETRAN through RENAVAM and to Banco Rendimento. 637 Tennis Club appears as a tennis and beach-tennis system, with bookings, administration and finance. This policy adds no metric, date or measured result.

privacyBlocks.title: Data-subject rights
paragraphs: Under article 18 of Law 13,709/2018, the data subject may request confirmation that processing exists and access to the data; correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data; anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary, excessive or unlawfully processed data; portability, subject to regulation and to trade secrecy; information about the entities with which the controller shared data; withdrawal of consent, when the basis of the processing is consent; and objection to processing based on legitimate interest, under article 18, paragraph 2.
The response period is 15 days from the request, under article 18, paragraph 5, extendable by another 15 days with a statement of reasons. The channel is a single one: contato@fisamtech.com.

privacyBlocks.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Contacts and commercial messages without a contract are kept for 12 months after the last contact. After that, the controller deletes or anonymizes the record, unless the dialogue continues or a retention duty applies.
Contract, diagnosis, payment and tax-document data are kept for 5 years after the contract or the service ends, in line with the applicable tax and civil limitation periods.
A report with no follow-up is kept for 12 months. A report with an inquiry or a measure is kept for the time of the inquiry and for 5 years after it ends.

The cookies NEXT_LOCALE, CURRENCY and COUNTRY last 12 months and renew with use. The IP address and the browser identifier of the administrative area are kept for the session, 12 hours, and, in the audit trail, for 6 months, unless an inquiry is under way.
Deletion: the data subject asks at contato@fisamtech.com. The controller deletes or anonymizes what is not under a legal retention duty and states what it had to keep and why.

termsBlocks.title: Parties

termsBlocks.title: Technical diagnosis
paragraphs: Checkout sells one technical-diagnosis session for R$ 4.990,00 (four thousand nine hundred and ninety Brazilian reais). The price pays for the diagnosis. It is not a deposit, it is not a mandatory start of a project, and an opinion not to proceed with a project creates neither a credit nor a duty to hire the rest.

The service is completed by delivery of the reading: situation, risks and next steps. The session is conducted by Filipe Godinho Gomes, the technical lead named on the site. A price in another currency is not published as a commercial price.

termsBlocks.title: Cancellation and refund
paragraphs: Before payment is confirmed, there is no charge.

After payment, if the analysis has not started and the cancellation request arrives within 7 days, there is a full refund by the same means, within 10 business days after cancellation is confirmed. The 7-day period follows article 49 of the Consumer Defense Code when the contracting party is the final recipient. The company extends the same period to a legal entity if the work has not started.
After the session has taken place or the reading has been delivered, the service has been rendered and the price is not refundable.
Later engineering work is not an off-the-shelf product and depends on a written proposal. These terms do not promise a refund of that work.

termsBlocks.title: Payment and scheduling

termsBlocks.title: Ideas

termsBlocks.title: Intellectual property

Whoever sends an idea or a report keeps title to what was sent and authorizes the company to read the material in order to consider a reply.

termsBlocks.title: Use of the site and administrative area

The administrative area exists for people authorized by the company. Access uses its own session, of up to 12 hours, and may record the IP address and the browser identifier of that session.

termsBlocks.title: Liability

This limit does not cover willful misconduct and does not set aside a right the law declares non-waivable, including a right of the consumer and of the data subject. The session is a professional reading. It is not a guarantee of a business result or of uninterrupted availability of the site.

code.title: Code of ethics and conduct
code.body: FISAM TECH states ethics, integrity, transparency, respect, responsibility, equal opportunity and a commitment to the law. The text asks for honesty with clients, suppliers and partners, compliance with applicable law, protection of confidential information, and a workplace without discrimination, harassment, intimidation, improper favor, corruption or fraud. A breach may lead to an administrative measure and, where it fits, notice to the authorities.

anticorruption.title: Anti-corruption and anti-bribery
anticorruption.body: The program forbids offering, promising, authorizing, requesting or accepting an improper advantage to influence a public or private decision. It cites Brazilian Law 12.846/2013. Commercial relationships should rest on technical merit and contractual transparency.

conflict.title: Conflict of interest
conflict.body: The program asks that a situation in which a personal, family or third-party interest could influence a company decision be declared to the compliance officer before the decision.

publicSector.title: Public sector and bids
publicSector.body: The program says bids and contracts with the public administration follow Brazilian Law 14.133/2021, and forbids collusion, fraud, an advantage to a public agent, and misuse of privileged information.

gifts.title: Gifts, travel and hospitality
gifts.body: The program allows a gift, hospitality or travel only when it is modest, occasional and without an expected return. It forbids cash and a benefit to a public agent meant to influence a decision.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Personal data processing observes Brazilian Law 13,709/2018. The privacy policy is the text in force and describes legal bases, retention, rights and the channel contato@fisamtech.com.

channel.title: Reporting channel
channel.body: The form stores the report and, if the person fills them in, name, email and phone. Identification is optional. The internal recipient is Filipe Godinho Gomes, at contato@fisamtech.com. If the report concerns him, the record remains stored for handling by whoever answers for the company. When an email is given, the company acknowledges receipt within 5 business days and makes a preliminary review within 15 business days. The company does not retaliate, in the commercial relationship it itself conducts, against a person who reports in good faith. The channel does not promise a criminal investigation or absolute anonymity.

governance.title: Review
governance.body: The program is reviewed when operations, the law or the company's structure change.

whistleblowing.title: Reporting channel
whistleblowing.lead: Channel to record a report about conduct related to FISAM TECH. Identification is optional. In force as of 10 November 2026.
whistleblowing.scopeBody: Category, narrative, approximate date and relation to the company. The form categories are corruption or bribery, fraud, harassment, conflict of interest, another irregularity, and other.
whistleblowing.guaranteesBody: Identification is optional. The option not to give a name, email and phone is checked by default. In that case the report proceeds without those data. If the person identifies themselves, the form stores name, email and phone and requires the corresponding authorization. The text of the report may identify someone. Passage through hosting and email is not absolute anonymity. The company does not retaliate, in the commercial relationship it itself conducts, against a person who reports in good faith.
whistleblowing.howBody: The form stores category, report, approximate date, relationship with the company and, if the person fills them in, name, email and phone. When the record is stored, the page shows a protocol in the form FT-WB, with the date and a suffix. If the record is not stored, the page shows no protocol. The company tries to send a notice to contato@fisamtech.com with the protocol and an excerpt of up to 280 characters, when email sending is active. The internal recipient is Filipe Godinho Gomes, representative of the controller. If the report concerns him, the record remains stored for handling by whoever answers for the company.
whistleblowing.anonymous: I do not want to give my name, email or phone
whistleblowing.name: Name
whistleblowing.consent: I authorize storing my name, email and phone with this report.
whistleblowing.disclaimer: Do not include someone else's data without need. If you identify yourself, consent is required to send.
whistleblowing.error: The report could not be sent.
whistleblowing.degraded: The report was not stored. There is no protocol. Try again or write to contato@fisamtech.com.
whistleblowing.successBody: Keep the protocol. It confirms the record. When an email is given, receipt is acknowledged within 5 business days.
whistleblowing.receiptBody: When the report includes an email, the company acknowledges receipt within 5 business days.
whistleblowing.analysisBody: The preliminary review takes place within 15 business days. The channel records and reviews what is within the company's reach. There is no promise of a criminal investigation.
whistleblowing.retentionBody: A report with no follow-up is kept for 12 months. A report with an inquiry or a measure is kept for the time of the inquiry and for 5 years after it ends.
